name: DI - Catalog Read API
description: Authenticated GET /webhook/di/catalog endpoint that reads all DI tables, joins solution assets/technologies/project usage/relationships, and returns UI-ready governed catalog data.

parameters.content:
## Delivery Intelligence Catalog Read API
GET /webhook/di/catalog?entity=overview|solutions|technologies|learnings|recommendations|relationships|jobs reads the full DI table set and returns UI-ready, governed records. It is additive and does not modify QA workflows.
